text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is a book published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from y.
Press(y) ::: y is a publishing house.
SpecializesIn(y, z) ::: y specializes in translating z into English.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Premises:
Press(newVesselPress) ∧ SpecializesIn(newVesselPress, foreignLiterature) ::: New Vessel Press specializes in translating foreign literature.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, English)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
NeapolitanChronicles :::
PublishedBy(NeapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ∧ TranslatedFrom(NeapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was published by New Vessel Press and translated from Italian.
Conclusion:
InLanguage(NeapolitanChronicles, English)
